description: The line plot illustrates the training loss over steps for various model architectures and sizes, using a dataset of 20 million samples. The x-axis represents the number of training steps, labeled as "Step," with values ranging from 0k to 440k in increments of 20k. The y-axis shows the training loss, labeled as "Train Loss," with values ranging from 0.0 to 0.85. Six distinct models are compared: ChemBART Small 20M (red), ChemBART Medium 20M (blue), ChemBERTa Small 20M (green), ChemBERTa Medium 20M (orange), ChemLLaMA Small 20M (purple), and ChemLLaMA Medium 20M (brown). All models exhibit a sharp initial decrease in training loss, with the loss values starting above 0.75 at 0k steps and rapidly declining to below 0.4 within the first 20k steps. After this initial drop, the loss curves for all models stabilize, showing a gradual decline and fluctuating around a value of approximately 0.1 to 0.15 by the end of the 440k steps. The ChemBERTa models (both small and medium) consistently show slightly lower training loss compared to the ChemBART and ChemLLaMA models throughout the training process.
